GAMECOCK - SEC Filing Truth Finder

Enhanced SEC data analysis tool focused on uncovering patterns and truth in financial filings.

Features:
- SEC EDGAR filing search and download
- Fails-to-Deliver (FTD) data analysis with anomaly detection
- Insider trading pattern detection
- Cross-reference analysis (Truth Finder mode)
- GME deep investigation dashboard with warrant analysis

Includes comprehensive GameStop analysis:
- 81.9M FTD shares (2020-2025)
- January 2021 squeeze mechanics
- October 2025 warrant dividend ($32 strike, 59M warrants)
- Current state: $7.84B cash, profitable, zero FTDs

Add project filesystem — agents can build things on disk

- preload.js: Electron IPC bridge for file system operations
  (writeFile, readFile, mkdir, readDir, exists, deleteFile, pickDirectory)
- main.js: IPC handlers, project directory management (~/.smoothbrain/settings.json),
  Project menu (Open folder Cmd+Shift+O, Change folder, Apply All Cmd+Shift+A)
- smoothbrain.html: APPLY button on every named code block writes file to project dir
  with full subdirectory support. Project bar shows current dir with Change/Open/Apply All.
  SAVE button now adds to workspace only (no auto-download).
- Default project dir: ~/Desktop/Smoothbrain/Projects/

Agents can now collaboratively build full project structures (like the
leak-proof-chat FastAPI app from a conversation) and the user can apply
all files to disk in one click.

Per-user dynamic ports to prevent cross-user data leakage

Each macOS user gets a consistent port offset derived from their
username (md5 hash % 100). Two users on the same machine will never
collide on ports, so they can't accidentally connect to each other's
server and see each other's images/videos.
